01 · Project overview

From financial records to meaningful reporting

At VS Information Systems, I independently developed a financial reporting solution for Altria, bringing sales, gross profit, operating expenses, net profit, receivables, payables and project performance into a connected Power BI experience. I worked on data cleaning, Power Query transformations, data modelling, DAX measures, navigation and visual design.

Accounting and finance relevance

Structured reporting helps users investigate financial performance, understand operating costs and monitor balances and obligations. These dashboard views support analysis and are not substitutes for statutory financial statements or an audit.

05 · Technical Development

What I contributed

01
Data preparation
Cleaned and transformed financial data using Power Query, preparing consistent fields for analysis.
02
Data modelling
Structured relationships and reporting dimensions for period, customer, division and project analysis.
03
DAX calculations
Built financial KPIs and period comparisons such as MTD, YTD, prior period and target achievement.
04
Dashboard design
Created interactive visual layouts, slicers, detail pages and navigation with financial stakeholders' reporting needs in mind.

How the financial measures work

Gross profit = Revenue − direct costs

Gross profit margin = Gross profit ÷ revenue × 100

Net profit margin = Net profit ÷ revenue × 100

Target achievement = Actual performance ÷ target × 100

Outstanding receivables = Unpaid customer invoice balances

Conceptual formula explanations. The original DAX code and source transaction tables were not provided, so this case study does not claim to reproduce the exact measures.

06 · Key Insights

What the reporting solution reveals

The March 2025 snapshot shows LKR 80.33M in revenue, LKR 40.24M in gross profit and LKR 24.84M in net profit. Sales target achievement was 83.83%, indicating performance below the dashboard's stated target for that reporting period. Together, the seven modules allow users to investigate revenue, margins, operating expenses, customer balances and project performance.

My contribution was building the reporting environment, not generating the financial results. The project strengthened my financial modelling, Power BI development and reporting skills.
